data.text: Which database driver should we use for the new async API?
I chose asyncpg over SQLAlchemy because asyncpg provides native async support with significantly better performance for high-concurrency workloads.
We always validate user input at the API boundary before it reaches the business logic layer.
I decided to avoid Redis for now because the data access patterns are simple enough that an in-process LRU cache handles the load.
Actually let's not use that approach — the LRU cache will cause inconsistency across multiple worker processes.
How should we handle authentication tokens?
I selected JWT with RS256 signing because asymmetric keys allow verification without exposing the signing secret to read-only services.
Let me think about whether we need refresh token rotation... probably yes for security.
